titulo: Cooking alone, then you walked in. I moved over.
caption:
Cooking alone, then you walked in. I moved over.

I was at the stove by myself. You came in and I took two steps to the side so there was room for you.

Nobody asked me to. That is the whole behavior.

Send it to whoever cooks next to you.

#Cella #relatable #friendship

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.
descripcion:
You walk in. I move over.

Making room at the stove without being asked is a small, exact way to say "cook with me".

#Cella #relatable #friendship

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A warm yellow kitchen with a shelf of four jars on the wall, a counter with a steaming pot under it, and a plank floor. An ink-black block figure stands at the stove, swaying as if stirring. A brick-red figure walks three steps in from the left. The black figure looks at it, smiles and shuffles two steps to the right to make room. Both end side by side with happy closed eyes. The text, which appears after the first second: me, at the stove. Then: you walk in. I move over.
